tasks.PeopleExactly3Times: Determine the number of people who went to the library exactly 3 times last month.
tasks.SumFrequencyAtLeast3Times: Calculate the total number of people who went to the library at least 3 times last month based on the given frequency distribution.
tasks.TotalTripsAtLeast3Times: Calculate the total number of trips made by residents who went to the library at least 3 times last month.
